messages:
Alice K: Quick heads-up — planning a stepwise unfreeze of feature flag llmroute_v3 during tonight's release window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
Ben S: Plan?
Alice K: Start with 1% for 10m, then 5% for 15m, 20% for 20m, then 100% if metrics look good. Holdpoints after each step.
Liz SRE: What metrics gate the next step? latency p95 < 350ms and error rate < 0.5% over the interval.
Paul PM: Adding a qualitative watch on top-queries failing for at least one customer cohort.
Ben S: We'll pin model version to v3.2.1 during the rollout — if we need rollback we can repin to v3.1.9 instantly.
Alice K: I'll post release notes link and the prompt set used for perf check.
Alice K: release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-23-llmroute
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @Alice K to begin at 02:05 UTC. CI: green. Canary infra warm.
Ben S: Can deploy-bot also attach the soft-rollback playbook when we hit holdpoint 2?
deploy-bot: ack — attaching playbook and will notify on trigger thresholds. Use `!rollback llmroute_v3` to start fast rollback.
Liz SRE: Who is on-call for SRE during the window? @Liz SRE and @maria-oncall today.
Paul PM: I'll be monitoring signal and help with customer comms if we tighten the cohort.
Ben S: Quick QA checklist: confirm KV cache cold-start < 150ms, kv-hit rate > 70% after step 2.
Alice K: Noted. We'll also enable prefix caching tweak in conf for the first 2 steps.
Ben S: If p95 creeps between 350-450ms but error rate stays <0.5%, we hold and increase replica count + adjust batching.
Liz SRE: If error >0.5% or spike in 5xxs, immediate rollback. No escalations needed before rollback.
Paul PM: Agreed. I'll draft a short in-product note for affected customers if we detect cohort regressions.
Alice K: Starting preflight checks now. I'll post a short summary 15m before the window.
Ben S: Thanks — tagging @deploy-oncall-bot so they see the plan :thumbsup:
deploy-oncall-bot: noted. We'll have one engineer standing by for rapid rollback. Good luck!
Alice K: final: keep the flag unfreeze plan idempotent: CLI for engineers:
```
# unfreeze sequence (example)
deploy-bot unfreeze-flag llmroute_v3 --step 1 --pct 1 --wait 600
deploy-bot unfreeze-flag llmroute_v3 --step 2 --pct 5 --wait 900
# ...
```
Ben S: perfect. See you in the window.
